commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+2' Jose Sanchez has a clear sight and sees a foul from Tommy Marques (Barcelona).
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
89' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
88' Corner kicks – 6:4. The percentage of ball possession is – 23:77.
87' The substitution has been made. Tommy Marques (Barcelona) has replaced Marc Bernal.
87' Barcelona players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
84' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Antonio Sivera comes off his line to intercept.
84' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) takes the corner kick, but Wojciech Szczesny reads it well and stops the effort.
83' Toni Martinez (Alaves) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Alaves.
82' A cross into the box from Pedri (Barcelona) is cleared.
81' The referee is firm and issues Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) a deserved yellow card.
80' Quique Sanchez Flores prepares a substitution. Victor Parada is replaced by Carlos Protesoni (Alaves).
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alejandro Balde trots off the pitch and is replaced by Joao Cancelo (Barcelona).
78' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
77' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. It's a throw-in for Alaves.
75' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) and Dani Olmo attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
73' Angel Perez (Alaves) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
72' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
71' Pedri (Barcelona) sends a long ball forward to Marcus Rashford, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
71' 9:8 – the total goal attempt statistics. Shots on target – 3:0.
69' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) sends a long cross over to Marcus Rashford, but Antonio Sivera comes forward to gather the ball.

68' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Jose Sanchez blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Barcelona will take a free kick near the side line.
68' The attendance for today's match is 19138.
67' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) strikes a powerful volley towards goal, but one of the defenders blocks his attempt.
64' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Pablo Ibanez (Alaves) replaces Denis Suarez.
64' Quique Sanchez Flores has decided to make a change. Aitor Manas (Alaves) replaces Ibrahim Diabate.
64' A long-range effort by Marc Bernal (Barcelona) after he received a good pass was well wide of the right post.
62' It's time for a substitution. Pedri (Barcelona) comes on in place of Marc Casado.
62' Substitution. Xavi Espart (Barcelona) on for Pau Cubarsi.
62' A substitution has been made. Roony Bardghji goes off and Ferran Torres (Barcelona) comes on.
60' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) collects a great pass, spins and releases a rocket of a shot from distance. Unluckily for him, it ends well wide of the left post.
59' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Jose Sanchez blows his whistle for a foul.
56' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) serves up a nice cross, but Antonio Sivera punches the ball away.
56' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
55' Roony Bardghji (Barcelona) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

55' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Jules Kounde (Barcelona), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Barcelona.
53' Good movement by Marc Casado (Barcelona), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
51' Angel Perez (Alaves) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Barcelona.

51' What a save from Wojciech Szczesny! Ibrahim Diabate (Alaves) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out.
47' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
46' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' 1 - 0 GOAL! Antonio Blanco meets a cross inside the box and heads the ball across the goal, where Ibrahim Diabate (Alaves) lurks and pokes it into the back of the net. 1:0.
45+1' Denis Suarez (Alaves) is about to take a corner kick.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Angel Perez (Alaves) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The linesman points to the corner flag, Alaves are going to take it.
45' Denis Suarez (Alaves) produces a header from long distance, but his naive attempt ends way over the bar.

42' Wojciech Szczesny makes a brilliant save! Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) easily weaves through the defence and fires the ball from mid-range. His low shot goes towards the middle of the goal but is saved by the keeper!
42' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Barcelona.
41' Marc Bernal (Barcelona) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
39' Jose Sanchez interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Pau Cubarsi (Barcelona).
36' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
35' He should have scored! Angel Perez (Alaves) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.

33' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
33' Barcelona are seeing far more of the ball now.
31' Total attempts – 4:6. The shots on goal statistics – 0:0.

30' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
29' Half-chance! Jules Kounde (Barcelona) plays a pass into the box, but Antonio Sivera reacts well to snuff out the attack.
27' Denis Suarez (Alaves) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
23' The Barcelona players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
21' Denis Suarez (Alaves) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
20' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Alaves get a corner.
18' Roony Bardghji (Barcelona) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

18' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Marc Casado (Barcelona) inside the box following a slide rule pass. The referee blows his whistle, Barcelona are awarded a corner kick.
17' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) plays a lovely through ball to Ibrahim Diabate, but he can't beat Wojciech Szczesny and loses the ball.
16' The ratio of the ball possession is 27:73.
15' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Denis Suarez (Alaves) took the corner.
14' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Now Alaves have a corner.
13' Barcelona seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
11' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
11' Roony Bardghji (Barcelona) will deliver the corner kick.
8' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) latches onto a long ball into the box and unleashes a fine volley at goal, but flashes the effort just wide of the left post. That would have been a great goal!
7' Roony Bardghji (Barcelona) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it well wide of the left post.
6' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
5' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) is penalised for holding. Jose Sanchez signals a set piece. Barcelona are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
4' It looks like Marc Casado (Barcelona) saw red with that tackle. Jose Sanchez won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
2' Denis Suarez (Alaves) takes the corner but it's cleared.
1' Ibrahim Diabate (Alaves) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. The ball goes out of play. Alaves are awarded a corner kick.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
